topic: Reporting a Broken Shared E-Scooter and Getting a Refund

script.title: THE BRAKE SAID MAYBE
script.scene_zh: 人行道邊 · 致電客服退費
script.story_hook: One broken brake, one long phone call.
script.intro_zh: 一個壞煞車，引來一通長長的客服電話。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's scooter story. Listen for complaints that stay friendly.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的電動車故事。留意如何友善地反映問題。
script.outro: And that's one refund plus a five-star exit. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 退款到位，還拿到五星告別。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat these lines together now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起把這些句子讀起來。
script.title_quote: the back brake just said maybe
script.char_a_description: a young college-age woman in her early twenties with shiny black hair in one thick side braid, a lavender windbreaker anorak, a canvas shoulder bag, and a slim athletic build
script.char_b_description: a friendly woman in her mid thirties with a chin-length platinum blonde bob, a small round earring, a soft grey turtleneck sweater, a teal headset microphone, and a relaxed medium build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the scooter support line?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈskuːtɚ səˈpɔɹt laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問接通的是共享電動車客服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, that's me on the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðæts mi ɑn ðə ˈlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 是的，我就是接電話的客服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, um, one of your scooters betrayed me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ʌm wʌn əv jɔɹ ˈskuːtɚz bɪˈtɹeɪd mi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，嗯，你們的一台車背叛了我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Betrayed? That's strong, what exactly happened?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈtɹeɪd ðæts stɹɑŋ wʌt ɪɡˈzæktli ˈhæpənd/
dialogue.zh: 背叛？講得好重，到底發生了什麼事？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The back brake just said maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk bɹeɪk dʒʌst sɛd ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 後煞車它只說：隨便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ouch, that word never means a fun ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊtʃ ðæt wɝd ˈnɛvɚ minz ə fʌn raɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哎喲，聽到這種描述就知道這趟不會好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It did not, I rolled into a hedge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪd nɑt aɪ ɹold ˈɪntu ə hɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 對，我整台車一路滾進了綠籬裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, are you hurt? That's the first question.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɑɹ ju hɝt ðæts ðə fɝst ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 等等，您受傷了嗎？這才是我最早要問的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope, just pride bruises and one torn sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp dʒʌst praɪd ˈbɹuzɪz ænd wʌn tɔɹn silv/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，只有尊嚴擦傷，外加一隻破袖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank goodness. Okay, which scooter was it?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs oʊˈkeɪ wɪtʃ ˈskuːtɚ wəz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 謝天謝地。好，是哪一台車？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ID is printed here, um, B-two-four-six-K.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði aɪˈdi ɪz ˈpɹɪntɪd hɪɹ ʌm bi tu fɔɹ sɪks keɪ/
dialogue.zh: 車身編號就在這，嗯，B-246K。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, scooter B-two-four-six-K, searching...
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ˈskuːtɚ bi tu fɔɹ sɪks keɪ ˈsɝtʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，B-246K，正在查詢……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: While you look, it's still charging me, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪl ju lʊk ɪts stɪl ˈtʃɑɹdʒɪŋ mi si/
dialogue.zh: 你查的時候，它還在跳費欸，你看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugh, yes, the trip never stopped on your side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ jɛs ðə tɹɪp ˈnɛvɚ stɑpt ɑn jɔɹ saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 噢，真的，您那邊的行程沒有停止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I parked it, folded it, everything by the book.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pɑɹkt ɪt ˈfoʊldɪd ɪt ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ baɪ ðə bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 我停車、收摺，每一步都照規矩做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the scooter ghosted the app, it happens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈskuːtɚ ˈɡoʊstɪd ði æp ɪt ˈhæpənz/
dialogue.zh: 那就是車子跟應用程式斷線了，偶爾會這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ghosted, ha, that's how my last date ended too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡoʊstɪd hɑ ðæts haʊ maɪ læst deɪt ˈɛndɪd tu/
dialogue.zh: 失蹤啊，哈，我上次約會也是這樣收場的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, poor you. Okay, I can kill the meter now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ pʊɹ ju oʊˈkeɪ aɪ kæn kil ðə ˈmitɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，您好可憐。好，我可以馬上把計費停掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, the number is climbing like a vine.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du ðə ˈnʌmbɚ ɪz ˈklaɪmɪŋ laɪk ə vaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，那個數字像藤蔓一樣往上爬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, frozen at... oh, forty-one minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ˈfɹoʊzən æt oʊ ˈfɔɹɾi wʌn ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 好了，停在……噢，四十一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty-one? I rode ten, the rest was panic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti wʌn aɪ ɹod tɛn ðə rɛst wəz ˈpænɪk/
dialogue.zh: 四十一分？我只騎了十分鐘，其餘都在慌張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic ghost trip, I've fixed twenty this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk ɡoʊst tɹɪp aɪv fɪkst ˈtwɛnti ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 典型的斷線行程，我這週已經處理二十次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, refund question, um, card or credit?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈɹiːfʌnd ˈkwɛstʃən ʌm kɑɹd ɔɹ ˈkɹɛdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那退款要回到信用卡，還是帳戶餘額？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your choice, card takes days, credit is instant.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ tʃɔɪz kɑɹd teɪkz deɪz ˈkɹɛdɪt ɪz ˈɪnstənt/
dialogue.zh: 您選，退卡要等幾天，存進帳戶馬上到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Credit, yes, I ride this thing weekly anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɹɛdɪt jɛs aɪ raɪd ðɪs θɪŋ ˈwikli ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就帳戶餘額，我原本每個星期都騎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, then a sorry-bonus goes with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl ðɛn ə ˈsɑɹi ˈboʊnəs ɡoʊz wɪð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，那我們再附一筆道歉紅利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bonus? Um, your company apologizes in dollars?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈboʊnəs ʌm jɔɹ ˈkʌmpəni əˈpɑlədʒaɪz ɪn ˈdɑɹləz/
dialogue.zh: 還有紅利？嗯，你們公司用美金道歉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars, consider it a sleeve repair fund.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈdɑɹləz kənˈsɪdɚ ɪt ə silv ɹɪˈpɛɹ fʌnd/
dialogue.zh: 五塊，請把它當成袖子修繕基金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, accepted. Now, where do I leave the patient?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪkˈsɛptɪd naʊ wɛɹ du aɪ liv ðə ˈpeɪʃənt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，收下。那，這位病人要留在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it blocking sidewalks, or safe by the hedge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈblɑkɪŋ ˈsaɪdˌwɔks ɔɹ seɪf baɪ ðə hɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 它擋到行人道了嗎，還是安安全全窩在綠籬邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half in the grass, half on the concrete.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɪn ðə ɡɹæs hæf ɑn ðə kənˈkɹit/
dialogue.zh: 一半躺在草地上，一半壓著水泥地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That spot's gray-zone, no fine, but not ideal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt spɑts ɡɹeɪ zɑn noʊ faɪn bʌt nɑt aɪˈdɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 那位置算灰色地帶，不會罰款，但不理想。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, the city flagged one for me last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ ðə ˈsɪɾi flæɡd wʌn fɚ mi læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 超慘，上個月我就因此吃過一張罰單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then do me a favor, nudge it two feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn du mi ə ˈfeɪvɚ nʌdʒ ɪt tu fit/
dialogue.zh: 那請幫個忙，往草裡再推兩英尺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, full grass now, like it lives there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʌn fʊl ɡɹæs naʊ laɪk ɪt ˈlɪvz ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好了，整台進草地了，像住在這一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect habitat, ha. And the brake, describe it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈhæbɪˌtæt hɑ ænd ðə bɹeɪk dɪˈskɹaɪb ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 完美棲地，哈。然後煞車，請形容一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lever squeezes, but stopping is a suggestion.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɛvɚ ˈskwizəz bʌt ˈstɑpɪŋ ɪz ə səˈdʒɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 拉桿捏得動，但『停下』只是它給的建議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ooh, that's a repair-tag line, I'll log it.
dialogue.phonetic: /u ðæts ə ɹɪˈpɛɹ tæɡ laɪn aɪl lɑɡ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這句我要標記給維修組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will someone rescue it before someone else crashes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ˈsʌmwʌn ˈɹɛskju ɪt bɪˈfɔɹ ˈsʌmwʌn ɛls ˈkɹæʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 會有人先來救它，免得別人都摔倒吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A truck sweeps broken ones every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tɹʌk swips ˈbɹoʊkən wʌnz ˈɛvɹi naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 收運車每晚都會來收壞掉的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every night, hmm, that's comforting for a night owl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi naɪtəm ðæts ˈkʌmfɚɾɪŋ fɚ ə naɪt ˈaʊl/
dialogue.zh: 每晚啊，嗯，這對夜貓族是個安慰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hey, our scooters, our headache, that's the deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ ɑɹ ˈskuːtɚz ɑɹ ˈhɛdˌeɪk ðæts ðə dil/
dialogue.zh: 我們的車、我們的麻煩，這是我們的本分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like that motto, print it on the helmets.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðæt ˈmoʊtoʊ prɪnt ɪt ɑn ði ˈhɛlməts/
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡這句口號，請印到安全帽上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll suggest it upstairs, no promises though.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl səɡˈdʒɛst ɪt ˌʌpˈstɛɹz noʊ ˈpɑmɪsɪz ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我向上頭提議，但不敢保證喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. So the refund plus bonus, all in my wallet?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ soʊ ði ˈɹiːfʌnd plʌs ˈboʊnəs ɔl ɪn maɪ ˈwɑlət/
dialogue.zh: 合理。那退款加紅利，都會進我的錢包？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both land within the hour, watch the app ping.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ lænd wɪˈðɪn ði ˈaʊɚ wɑtʃ ði æp pɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一小時之內都會入帳，留意應用程式的通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ping, got it. Um, should I ride this model again?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪŋ ɡɑɾ ɪt ʌm ʃʊd aɪ raɪd ðɪs ˈmɑdəl əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 通知，收到。嗯，這種車型我還能再騎嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Newer batches fixed this, yours is an old build.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnuɚ ˈbætʃɪz fɪkst ðɪs jʊɹz ɪz æn oʊld bɪld/
dialogue.zh: 新型號改善了這問題，您那台是舊版。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I'll scan twice and test the brake first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪl skæn twaɪs ænd tɛst ðə ˈbɹeɪk ˈfɝst/
dialogue.zh: 好，以後我會多掃兩次碼，先試煞車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart rider, the brake test saves everyone's day.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈɹaɪdɚ ðə bɹeɪk tɛst seɪvz ˈɛvɹiˌwʌnz deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很會騎呢，試煞車這一步能救全場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll frame that one too, next to the sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl ˈfɹeɪm ðæt wʌn tu ˈnɛkst tə ðə silv/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這句我也要裱起來，跟破袖子掛一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. Anything else for you today, Nina?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls fɚ ju təˈdeɪ ˈninə/
dialogue.zh: 成交。Nina，今天還有別的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope, um, that's everything, you're a lifesaver.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp ʌm ðæts ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ jʊɹz ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有了，嗯，這樣就齊了，你是救星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ride safe, and thank you for reporting clearly.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪd seɪf ænd θæŋk ju fɚ ɹɪˈpɔɹtɪŋ ˈklɪɹli/
dialogue.zh: 騎車注意安全，謝謝您說明得這麼清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do, next time I'll pick a bicycle.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du nɛkst taɪm aɪl pɪk ə ˈbaɪsɪkəl/
dialogue.zh: 會的，下次我改租自行車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, bikes can't ghost... unless they're also app-run.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ baɪks kænt ɡoʊst ʌnˈlɛs ðɛɹ ˈɔlsoʊ æp ɹʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，自行車不會失蹤……除非它也是手機管的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Point taken, bye for now, five-star support.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt ˈteɪkən baɪ fɚ naʊ faɪv stɑɹ səˈpɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，先講到這，五星客服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five stars? Careful, praise makes me float.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv stɑɹz ˈkɛɚfəl pɹeɪz meɪks mi floʊt/
dialogue.zh: 五星？小心，誇獎聽多了我會飄起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, enjoy it, scooter whisperer.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ɪt ˈskuːtɚ ˈwɪspɚɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，慢慢享受吧，電動車輕語師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Nina, may all your brakes be boring.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈninə meɪ ɔl jɔɹ ˈbɹeɪks bi ˈbɔɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 再見，Nina，願您的煞車永遠無聊。

script.youtube_title: 【電動車煞車擺爛🛴】「後煞車它只說：隨便」💸計費停不下來怎麼辦📱｜退費・紅利・申告全流程｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜E-Scooter Refund
script.youtube_title_en: "The Back Brake Just Said Maybe" — Reporting a Broken E-Scooter
script.youtube_description:
「後煞車它只說：隨便」——一台共享電動車煞車失靈，騎進綠籬，計費卻還一路跳動，你站在人行道邊撥打客服電話。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在路邊的一通申訴電話裡。

你會聽到：怎麼開口描述煞車壞掉、自己有沒有受傷；報車身編號、請客服立刻停掉計費；退款要回信用卡還是帳戶餘額、怎麼選；壞車停到一半在草地一半在水泥地，會不會吃罰單；還有請維修單位把車帶走的說法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人反映問題時的真實語感：um、ugh、ha、oh。聽完你就會用：what exactly happened?、it's still charging me、card or credit?、Anything else for you today?。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The back brake just said maybe" — a shared e-scooter's brake gives up mid-ride, you roll into a hedge, and the meter keeps running. Now you stand on the sidewalk calling support. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built around one refund phone call.

You will hear: describing a broken brake without panicking; confirming nobody is hurt; reading the scooter ID and stopping the charge; choosing between a card refund and instant account credit; gray-zone parking and city fines; plus reporting the vehicle for pickup by the nightly repair truck.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk Americans actually use when complaining kindly: um, ugh, ha, oh. By the end you'll own phrases like It's still charging me, Card or credit?, and What exactly happened?

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
共享電動車騎到一半煞車失靈，人沒傷到，計費卻還在跳，這通客服電話該怎麼打，才拿得回退款？退到信用卡還是帳戶？壞車留在路邊會不會罰款？

這一集帶大家站上人行道邊，從申告煞車故障、報車身編號、請客服停止計費，一路聽到退款方式選擇、罰單疑慮與臨別玩笑，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🛴 描述故障：The back brake just said maybe.
📱 停計費：While you look, it's still charging me, see?
💸 選退款：So, refund question, um, card or credit?
🧾 收尾：Both land within the hour, watch the app ping.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、ugh、ha、oh 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著打完這通電話，下次遇到計費亂跳，你也能禮貌又堅定地拿回自己的錢。

願你的每一次煞車，都無聊得很安心。
